description: Presidential Secretariat - Notified that Minister of  Finance and Mass Media has Resigned his Office, w.e.f. 22.02.2019
reasoning: This gazette content solely announces the resignation of a named individual (Hon. Mangala Samaraweera) from his government position (Member of Parliament, Minister of Finance and Mass Media). It does not contain any details about the responsibilities of the portfolio or any structural/administrative changes to the government itself. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2), which covers government personnel changes like appointments, resignations, and retirements.
